observations.body: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Hebrews quotes the wilderness provocation and repeatedly says “today.”
observations.label: The warning speaks today

observations.body: The Spirit’s present voice carries Meribah, testing, works, wandering hearts, and forty years to new hearers.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Hebrews 3:6–10 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Past failure becomes present warning without making the later hearers identical to the ancestors.
payload.title: The wilderness voice becomes present speech
